decision rationale: Both configuration roles reached rubric pass rate 1.00 on the three development evaluation cases, and every acceptance condition permitted adoption of the candidate configuration (maximum latency 174.235 s of 330.0 s, review effort 2 minutes of 5, no unsupported generation, no candidate definition on EC-05-3). The roles used the same model and differ only by instruction profile, so the decision is bounded to these development cases and does not authorize a canonical knowledge collection write.
scope: The bounded configuration decision rests on the declared development evaluation cases and supplies no held-out evidence.
authority boundary: The bounded configuration decision does not select a retrieval configuration and authorizes no write to the canonical knowledge collection.
